values.binNote: Bin's MelE#AreaDamagePerSecond (BaseAreaDamage[16..64] + 0.08xap) is a per-second rate; the wiki reports the per-tick amount, dividing by MelE.AreaTicksPerSecond=8 (16/8=2 ... 64/8=8, 0.08/8=0.01=1% AP), which matches this quote.

mechanics.claim: The orb deals a single instance of area damage on impact, separate from the lingering field's damage-over-time instances.
mechanics.quote: The initial impact of ''Solar Snare'' deals {{tip|area damage}}, while the lingering damage over time deals {{tip|persistent area damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The field expands to its full radius only after a 0.5 second delay following the orb's impact.
mechanics.quote: The orb emanates a field of solar radiation that additionally expands after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay.

mechanics.claim: The field damages and slows every 0.125 seconds, and continues to tick for 0.25 seconds after a target leaves the field.
mechanics.quote: Enemies within the field are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% every {{fd|0.125}} seconds, lingering for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after exiting.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield only blocks the orb's root, not the field's damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the orb ({{tip|root}} portion).

mechanics.claim: Both the orb and the field deal 50% damage against minions.
mechanics.quote: Both the orb and the field of ''Solar Snare'' deal {{#expr:{{#var:mmod}}*100}}% damage against {{tip|minions}}.
